## Problem and users

What task should the skill help with? When should it trigger or stay inactive?
How does it differ from existing skills?

## Sources and rights

List proposed source URLs/versions, attribution and redistribution licenses.
Is this authored guidance or maintained upstream material?

## Helpers and validation

Describe any executable helpers, prerequisites, network use and side effects.
Give representative prompts, expected results and proposed checks.

## Scope and artifacts

Generic skill registration or a separately reviewed maintained-source updater?
Link draft/approved intent, spec and plan as each stage is reviewed.
